summary: Operator hygiene for #634 durable spend: reset_budget_spend zeros today's spend.json counters; CLI gh plate autonomy --budget-reset and MCP plate_autonomy_budget reset=true restore remaining without changing .plate limits (#634/#653).
migration_impact: Additive CLI/MCP flags. Local spend.json may be zeroed intentionally; does not alter token_budget or risk_tolerance. Downstream adopters get a safe way to clear test/loop debris that false-exhausted what_next budget_gate.
migration_guidance: 1. When plate_what_next prioritizes budget_gate but risk_tolerance=off and spend is test debris: gh plate autonomy --budget-reset (or plate_autonomy_budget reset=true).
2. Re-run gh plate autonomy --budget / plate_what_next; remaining should restore to daily limit.
3. Prefer use_live_budget=False in unit tests so spend.json is not charged outside isolated base_dir.
agent_notes: reset_budget_spend is operator hygiene, not a bypass of live gates for unsupervised AutonomyEngine runs. Keep risk_off vs enforce semantics. Always isolate tests via base_dir.
